# Municipal Ordinance No. 05, Series of 2014

**Isang Kapasiyahan na Nagpapatibay sa Isang Kautusang Bayan Hinggil sa Proklamasyon ng Pangulohng Benigno Simeon Aquino III na may Bilang na 494 na Nag-Uutos na Isama sa Order ng Kanik and Half Rice Serving sa Bawat Menu ng Publiko at Pribadong Bawan**

Kapasiyahan 199

## Summary

Reiterates and strengthens the implementation of Proclamation No. 494 by President Benigno Simeon Aquino III, ordering all public and private eateries and restaurants in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] to include a half-rice serving option (kanik) in every menu. Implements the National Health Insurance Program ([[PhilHealth]]) under RA 9241 and references the [[Food and Nutrition Research Institute]] guidelines on nutrition.

Related to [[MO-005-S2013]], which first adopted this measure.

## Key Provisions

- **Half-Rice Serving Mandate:** All public and private restaurants, eateries, and food establishments must offer a half-rice serving option in their menus
- **PhilHealth Implementation:** Supports RA 9241 on National Health Insurance Program
- **Nutrition Policy:** References Food and Nutrition Research Institute findings on Filipino dietary health

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]

- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
